rawContent: I forgot that I wrote this back in 2017. As you see, I try to keep a steady perspective and I’m no fair weather supporter of the inestimable @RepMaxineWaters! And I remain a champion of #BlackTwitter because #BlackPoliticsMatter because #BlackLivesMatter. It’s simple. #BOOM #POW

I empathize with her feelings of loss and despair; but most of the #Ferguson activists were NOT murdered. We need to accept the truth about the MANY failures of Ferguson and #BlackLivesMatter. The truth will set you free and prevent the same mistakes. A lot of people are lying.
